description: Accounts, likely related to AIU VII.F.56 (PGPID 30663). Probably in the scribal hand of Meʾīr Ben-Naʿīm (fl. 1785-1825). Many of the items listed are clothing. This fragment may have once belonged to a single ledger comprised of other shelfmarks in the AIU.VII.F series. Requires further examination. MCD.
